item.title: Prosecutor defends human smuggling charges against Kilmar Abrego Garcia
item.description: A federal judge is weighing whether to dismiss the criminal case against Kilmar Abrego Garcia on the grounds the prosecution is vindictive.

item.title: 2/26: CBS Evening News
item.description: What happened during Hillary Clinton's House deposition on Epstein; Boy who lost Pokémon binder gets over 15,000 cards from strangers

item.title: Federal Reserve seeking to quash subpoenas in DOJ investigation, source says
item.description: The Federal Reserve has been mounting a closed-door effort to block the Justice Department's subpoenas for chairman Jerome Powell, CBS News has learned.

item.title: Columbia student released after being detained by DHS agents
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security said ICE agents detained Elmina "Ellie" Aghayeva at Columbia University Thursday, saying her student visa was revoked in 2016. She was later released.

item.title: Pentagon official lashes out at Anthropic as talks break down
item.description: The Pentagon's top technology official told CBS News the military has offered compromises to Anthropic, amid a feud over whether its powerful AI technology will be restricted — but Anthropic called the offer inadequate.

item.title: Pentagon shoots down Customs and Border Protection drone in Texas, officials say
item.description: The Defense Department on Wednesday shot down a U.S. Customs and Border Protection drone in southwest Texas, federal officials confirmed to CBS News.

item.title: Photo of Lutnick on Epstein's island removed from DOJ files now restored
item.description: A photo released last month as part of the Epstein files that showed Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick with convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein on Epstein's island was removed from the DOJ's website before being restored Thursday night.

item.title: Pakistan says it is in "open war" with Afghanistan, launches strikes on Kabul
item.description: Pakistan bombed major cities in Afghanistan on Friday, including the capital Kabul. Islamabad has accused Afghanistan of failing to act against militant groups that carry out attacks in Pakistan.

item.title: 2/26: The Takeout: The Iran Question
item.description: In a special edition of "The Takeout," Major Garrett speaks with experts about escalating tensions over Iran's nuclear program and the potential political consequences of U.S. intervention as President Trump considers strikes if no deal is reached.

item.title: The Strange Shooting of Alex Pennig
item.description: A nurse is found dead in her apartment. Surveillance video captures her coming home for the last time. Can investigators piece together what happened next? "48 Hours" contributor Natalie Morales reports.
